links.outcome: Rate of incompetent responses and hallucinations in LLM clinical answers
links.effect: 3-19% of LLM responses were rated as incompetent and 40 instances of LLM hallucination were identified.
links.quote: Despite these strengths, 3-19% LLM responses were rated as incompetent and 40 instances of LLM hallucination were also identified.

unlisted_practices: Blinded randomized multi-specialty expert panel evaluation framework using a Dreyfus-based career-stage scoring scale

screen.reason: The study develops an evaluation framework (Medieval) and conducts an expert reader evaluation of seven LLMs on 685 clinical cases to assess performance and hallucination rates, but does not test a specific organizational safeguard or deployment practice.
